meta.homeTitle: Vladyslav Otroshchenko — Frontend Engineer (React, Next.js, GSAP)
meta.homeDescription: Frontend engineer with 10+ years of experience. Websites, React and Next.js applications and motion-rich interfaces for luxury brands, auction houses and growing products.
meta.workDescription: Selected projects: websites for independent watchmakers, Ineichen Auctioneers, Artle, e-commerce and React applications.
meta.contactDescription: Tell me about your website or web application. I reply within two working days.

hero.lead: I build fast, search-friendly websites and React applications, with motion that makes people stay.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: For over a decade I’ve built web interfaces from scratch, from single landing pages to multi-page applications. Lately the work is React, Next.js and TypeScript with server rendering, typed data from Supabase and Zod, and animation that stays at 60 FPS.

tehmart.text: UI systems and non-standard responsive layouts for luxury brands and high-traffic platforms, including Konstantin Chaykin and Ineichen Auctioneers. Animation and micro-interactions with GSAP and Three.js at 60 FPS. Applications built from zero on React, Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript, with Supabase and Zod for full-stack features.

stmaria.text: Rebuilt the frontend of a live OpenCart store: responsive UI, faster mobile pages, cleaner technical SEO and analytics pipelines for Google, Seznam and Heureka.
stmaria.statLabel: people on the site at the same time after the rebuild, up from 30–40. Daily orders grew from 5–6 to 160+.

helpmed.text: Hybrid mobile interfaces on Angular and Ionic for a telemedicine service, real-time UI on Meteor.js, and Twig/XSLT templates that turned XML and REST data into maintainable pages.

skills.title: Skills and technologies
skills.intro: What I work with every day, grouped the way I use it on projects.

notes.ai: I use AI tools daily to scaffold components, refactor, write tests and review code faster. Architecture decisions stay mine, and every line is read before it ships.

services.title: Development to order
services.intro: I take on a small number of projects at a time, so each one gets my full attention from the first layout to launch. AI tools speed up the routine work; the details are done by hand.

sites.title: Websites and landing pages
sites.text: A fast, search-friendly site built from your design, or with one. Pixel-accurate layouts, content you can edit yourself, and pages that load in under a second.

apps.title: React web applications
apps.text: Dashboards, shops and internal tools with typed data from the database to the button. Authentication, forms, payments and an architecture the next developer can read.

motion.title: Animation and interactive
motion.text: Scroll stories, product reveals and 3D scenes for brands that want visitors to stay. Motion that stays smooth on a mid-range phone and respects reduced-motion settings.

performance.title: Speed and technical SEO
performance.text: An audit of an existing site with a clear list of fixes, then the fixes themselves: Core Web Vitals, image and font loading, structured data and crawlable markup.
